strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux to Linux or Windows using unordered FakeTCP/FEC carriers plus a native standards-compliant DTLS 1.3 WBD security/session layer. Xray/VLESS/Vision/REALITY, WireGuard and Android are not part of the V2.1 product stack.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2-M2 native WBD DTLS 1.3 security shim; M2A identity and M2B datagram independence passed, M2C raw/FEC integration active
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Keep M2 on one DTLS association and one raw lane. Do not add custom FEC, two lanes, kernel-anchor work, native TUN/session features, Auto, custom post-handshake crypto or detector-specific fingerprint shaping. First prove the qualified DTLS shim composes with the exact M1 UDPspeeder/udp2raw baseline, then measure the 0/1/5/10/15% family.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed V2-M2B at substantive checkpoint b9b505395f3bbf31b4279d492b15f2506f0f8483. A thin bidirectional wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 UDP shim was locally qualified against the M2A-qualified build and certificate path. Direct localhost relay delivered 5/5 numbered datagrams in both directions with one plaintext UDP receive mapped to one wolfSSL_write and one successful wolfSSL_read mapped to one plaintext UDP send. A deterministic post-handshake proxy then dropped exactly the next client-to-server encrypted UDP datagram after 12 forwarded DTLS packets; msg-01 was lost while msg-02 and msg-03 were still independently authenticated, decrypted and echoed, proving no DTLS record-order HOL. The accepted local shim source SHA-256 is e45680a297645812ac5da2133d4357408e81776607ba641c192e1f874e4768ab and accepted binary SHA-256 is 90cc3bf45d1b23cd1848159e730a6b80a2e16221177da5b83078d4db75b22e65. Reproducible driver, receipt, report and security lock update were committed.
continuation_cursor.current_task: V2-M2C: insert the qualified DTLS 1.3 shim between the exact M1 UDPspeeder and udp2raw components on one FakeTCP lane. Start with a clean 20:20 local smoke using the same isolated classic-faketcp/RST-suppression environment, then add the first 1% impairment case only after clean composition passes.
continuation_cursor.why_now: M2A proved identity/security and M2B proved record independence without carrier complexity. The remaining architectural risk is composition: DTLS handshake/application records must traverse the already-qualified FakeTCP lane while UDPspeeder source/repair datagrams remain independently recoverable. A clean smoke isolates wiring/MTU/state issues before the full weak-network matrix.
continuation_cursor.done_when: The exact pinned UDPspeeder 20230206.0 -> qualified WBD DTLS 1.3 shim -> exact pinned udp2raw 20230206.0 one-lane topology runs locally with the M2A wbd.test certificate path, first at 0% and then at 1% impairment. Application echo delivery is complete, DTLS remains DTLSv1.3 with the qualified cipher, and logs/counters prove UDPspeeder encoded datagrams cross as DTLS application records. No two-lane, kernel-anchor, TUN/session or Auto work is admitted. After 0%/1% composition passes, expand M2 to 5/10/15% and security-overhead/CPU accounting.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: V2-M2C: reuse the committed M1 namespace/FakeTCP harness and exact pinned udp2raw/UDPspeeder binaries. Wire UDPspeeder client encoded output to the DTLS client shim plaintext listener; wire the shim transport through udp2raw; on the server side wire udp2raw UDP output into the DTLS server transport listener and its decrypted plaintext target into UDPspeeder server. Run a 20:20 clean smoke first. If and only if it reaches stable DTLS READY and complete application echo delivery, repeat at 1% forward encoded/FEC-datagram impairment and record the delta from M1.
